# Suggested repository labels

Create these labels in the GitHub UI (**Issues → Labels**) or with the GitHub CLI:

```bash
gh label create companion --color "1D76DB" --description "New or updated companion character"
gh label create qol --color "0E8A16" --description "Quality-of-life improvement"
gh label create bug --color "D73A4A" --description "Something isn't working"
gh label create docs --color "0075CA" --description "Documentation only"
gh label create out-of-scope --color "B60205" --description "Closed or declined as out of project scope"
```

Issue templates already apply `companion` or `qol` where appropriate.
